lines.speaker: N
lines.text: She retired in the calm sixties. He retired into the Great Depression. Same million dollars, same forty thousand a year. *She* ran out. Why?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: But prices fell too. My money stretched further.

lines.speaker: J
lines.text: Nineteen sixty-six. No crash. Just prices going up, *year after year*.

lines.speaker: J
lines.text: By nineteen eighty-two, prices had *nearly tripled*.

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Thirty years later, I still have *seven hundred forty-nine thousand*.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Since eighteen seventy-one, only six start years ran out. All six were in the sixties. The crash didn't sink Walt. *Rising prices* sank June.
